messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 PAGER: P1 - idp-prod log forwarder detected external sink + possible auth header leakage. Runbook: /runbooks/idp-log-leak. Paging oncall.
amy_oncall: I'm on. What's the immediate customer impact? link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1755551230
tom_sec: seeing repeated POSTs from idp -> telemetry-forwarder. A handful of log lines contain 'Authorization: Bearer' fragments. Need containment now.
raj_infra: Taking idp logshipper down from infra cluster: `kubectl scale deployment/idp-logshipper -n infra --replicas=0`
deploy-bot: command executed by raj_infra: kubectl scale deployment/idp-logshipper -n infra --replicas=0 -> scaled.
amy_oncall: Good. I've opened an incident doc and snapshot. Starting a grep to quantify exposures: `gsutil cat gs://idp-prod-logs/* | grep -E "Authorization: Bearer" | wc -l`
tom_sec: If grep > 0 we'll need to rotate affected client secrets and service tokens. I'll start mapping token families in the samples.
miguel_cs: Do we have a list of customer tokens that could appear in those logs? Need to prepare outreach if so.
zoe_legal: Do not notify customers externally until we confirm scope and craft language. Preserve logs and metadata for chain-of-custody. Requesting retention freeze.
amy_oncall: Freezing forwarder sink and retention: `gcloud logging sinks update idp-prod-forwarder --disabled` -> done. Pulled 4 suspect files and redacted a sample for triage.
tom_sec: redacted sample:
```
{ "ts": "2026-02-14T12:02:59Z", "req": "POST /oauth/introspect", "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer xxxxxxx....xxx" }, "user": "client-abc" }
```
Also saved client IDs to /tmp/exposed-client-ids.txt. Initial scan shows ~12 unique client IDs.
raj_infra: Preparing rotation plan. Running: `scripts/rotate-idp-client-secrets.sh --batch --concurrency=2` on canary first.
amy_oncall: Tasking: tom_sec -> forensics + token rotation plan; raj_infra -> execute rotation + deploy; miguel_cs -> draft customer outreach (hold until legal sign-off); zoe_legal -> review messaging; me -> status page + internal updates.
miguel_cs: Drafted outreach: concise + next steps + mitigation. Will attach once legal gives thumbs up. Will also assemble list of potentially affected accounts: acct-RED-001, acct-ORCH-002 (redacted IDs).
zoe_legal: Edited wording for regulator-safe phrasing. Once final I'll sign-off for CS to send. Keep a copy in evidence bucket.
amy_oncall: Timeline so far: detection 12:03 UTC, forwarder disabled 12:08 UTC, initial artifacts pulled 12:10 UTC, rotation started 12:15 UTC. Logging these in incident doc.
deploy-bot: rotate-idp-client-secrets.sh completed on canary (raj_infra). Rolling to 3 pods now.
tom_sec: Forensics update: no outbound egress patterns observed beyond the misconfigured forwarder. No signs of targeted exfil. Continuing log audit and token validation.
miguel_cs: Prepped customer template and internal FAQ. Waiting legal approval to send. Notifying account reps.
amy_oncall: Handing off active watch to night oncall (sam_oncall) at 23:00 UTC. If anything spikes page SRE/PAGER immediately. Closing active mitigation loop for now; postmortem and notif timeline will be updated in doc.
